common_issues.issue: Can't log into the teller system after an update
common_issues.likely_cause: Recent updates sometimes change the authentication method or reset cached credentials.
options: Walk through the new login process
Send the password reset portal link
Open a ticket with Branch Systems Support (typical response: 15-20 min)

common_issues.likely_cause: Device re-registration is usually needed after a network migration or a phone swap.
options: Open a ticket with IAM Helpdesk

common_issues.likely_cause: Biometric templates occasionally need re-enrollment after firmware updates or hardware swaps.

Open a ticket with IAM Helpdesk
